test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

She __has given__ a brilliant dance performance last week.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the present perfect tense 'has given' is incorrect because it is used with actions that have relevance to the present moment.
 
• The simple past tense 'gave' is more appropriate as it indicates an action that was completed in the past.
 
• Therefore, the correct verb form to use is 'gave'.

Hence the correct statement is '*She **gave** a brilliant dance performance last week*.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** present perfect tense** is used for actions that have relevance to the present moment or for actions that started in the** past** and continue to the** present.**
 
• The **simple past tense** is used for actions that were completed at a specific point in the **past.**
